meta.what: The occupation after the first night: the sweep, the order sheet and curfew, searches, detention, the watchlist. Each number has <key>_src and <key>_basis: reported (the source gives it), derived (worked out from reported figures) or play (the source gives the shape, the number was chosen so the game can be played).
meta.research: docs/research/occupation.md (cited as occupation.md and a section number)

sweep.first_day_src: occupation.md 1.1, 1.2, 6.4: soldiers swept every building in the first days (Bucha, Hostomel); the first 72 hours. Day 1 is 18 January, the morning after the crossing
sweep.last_day_src: as first_day: within the first 72 hours
sweep.hour_from_src: no source for the hours: searches by daylight
sweep.warning_min_src: no source: boots and shouting on the stairs before they reach your door

order.posted_hour_src: occupation.md 1.4: in Kherson the conditions came on day 2 of the occupation (2 March 2022). Here noon on 18 January, the day after the crossing
order.curfew_from_src: occupation.md 1.4: curfew 20:00 to 06:00 (Kherson, Ukrainska Pravda 2 Mar 2022)

inspection.man_taken_p_src: occupation.md 1.1: troops 'sometimes took men away' in the Bucha sweep, and detained every man on one street in Nova Basan; no source gives a rate
inspection.woman_taken_p_src: occupation.md 2.3: 88% of the UN's 864 detainees were men, 7.3 men for every woman; 0.08 / 7.3
inspection.contraband_detain_p_src: occupation.md 1.2: weapons and communication devices are what led to detention in the sources; the share that were let go is not given
inspection.armed_shot_p_src: occupation.md 1.5: of 100 killings the UN examined, 27 were people killed on the spot after troops took control; no per-search rate
inspection.forced_door_mul_src: occupation.md 1.1: told to leave doors unlocked; a locked door was forced and the flat wrecked. How much worse it went for the owner is not given
inspection.cache_found_p_src: no source for how often hidden things were found
inspection.loot_share_src: occupation.md 1.6: soldiers took food and household goods in searches (Bucha, Hostomel, Balakliia); the share is not given
inspection.suspicion_doubles_at_src: no source: being known for something raises the odds a search ends badly

detention.length_split_src: occupation.md 6.8: about 40% under 4 days, 35% 4-30 days, 20% 1-4 months, 5% moved to Russia or never seen again, fitted to the lengths in 2.3 (1 day to about 4 months)
detention.death_p_src: occupation.md 2.3: 5 of 226 Kherson detainees died in or shortly after custody (Yale HRL)
detention.ill_treated_p_src: occupation.md 2.3: about a quarter allegedly tortured (Yale HRL, Kherson); over 91% of the UN's interviewees, which is not a rate
detention.kcal_per_day_src: occupation.md 2.3: one portion of cereal a day, or three 250 g ration cans per five people every two days (about 150 g a day)
detention.illness_per_day_src: occupation.md 2.3: crowded cells, no medical care; no rate
detention.cooperate_p_src: occupation.md 2.3: some were released after signing a promise to cooperate or filming a video; the share is not given

suspicion.radio_call_src: occupation.md 2.2: people thought to hold security information, and contact with Ukrainian forces, were targeted; the weight is play
suspicion.fpv_launch_src: occupation.md 1.2: drones were among what got people detained
suspicion.rally_src: occupation.md 2.2: Territorial Defence members and organisers were tier 1 of the lists
suspicion.contraband_found_src: found with weapons or a radio
suspicion.listed_at_src: occupation.md 2.2: lists were built from seized records and widened to anyone seen as opposing the occupation; where the line falls is play

visits.from_day_src: occupation.md 6.4: after the sweep, visits come in waves and target listed people
visits.p_per_day_at_100_src: no source for how often: a visit on about one day in three for someone fully known
visits.hour_from_src: occupation.md 1.1: armed men visited the homes of known activists, sometimes at 6 a.m. (Kherson)
visits.listed_detain_p_src: occupation.md 2.2-2.3: over half of the 226 Kherson abductions happened at home; how many visits ended in one is not given
visits.cache_found_p_src: a targeted search looks harder than the sweep; no source
